variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished, high fidelity review board for the existing Huevia Android/iOS camera app in simplified Chinese. It must look like a careful evolution of its original Android design: warm off-white #F8F7F4 background, near-black #242420 text and primary pill buttons, very pale warm-gray #EEECE6 surfaces, white rounded cards, simple functional outline icons, generous but practical spacing, crisp Chinese typography. No colorful gradients, no glossy glass, no photos, no device hardware marketing render, no bottom app tab bar on this connection subpage. Large readable text. No implementation details.

Canvas: a landscape design board with TWO fully visible tall mobile screens side by side at identical scale. Left screen is the INITIAL DEFAULT Wi-Fi state. Right screen is the same design after selecting USB. Small labels above the screens: “默认 · Wi-Fi” and “切换 · USB”. The board title must clearly identify the requested variant. Show a simple back arrow and “连接相机” on BOTH screens. Both Wi-Fi and USB must always be visibly available, one tap switches the content BELOW without entering another page. Initial state MUST select Wi-Fi, never USB. Treat this as one universal connector used by preset import, camera photos, remote shutter and live transfer.

Wi-Fi screen exact Chinese text to use, concise and readable: “相机品牌”, “尼康”, “开启相机 Wi-Fi”, “在手机设置中连接相机热点”, “返回 Huevia 后点击连接”, secondary “查看连接指引”, bottom main button “连接相机”.
USB screen exact text: “使用数据线连接相机”, “按系统提示允许访问”, a camera device card “尼康 Z6 II” with subdued status “已检测到 · 等待授权”, secondary “重新检测”, bottom main button “授权并连接”. Use a USB trident icon, never a Wi-Fi icon for USB.
Both screens footer: “连接成功后返回当前功能”. All layouts must retain large image-free readable controls, clear inactive versus selected connection methods, realistic touch sizes. Do not show a successful-connection state or a green connected badge. These are proposed design views, not proof that a physical device has connected. Avoid tiny text, English filler and extra buttons.
Variant A title: “A · 顶部双标签”. Use a wide continuous warm-gray capsule immediately below the title with two labels “Wi-Fi 无线” and “USB 有线”; the selected half is a WHITE pill with dark bold text. This deliberately matches the app's existing Sync segmented-control style. Below it, display a compact large icon and short connection instructions with numbered lines, one camera-brand row on Wi-Fi or one detected-device card on USB. Plenty of clear spacing; keep the main black pill CTA fixed near the bottom. This is the most familiar and compact version. Both screen headers and capsule positions must align exactly.

Variant B title: “B · 展开式方式卡片”. Instead of a segmented control, show TWO VERTICAL connection-method cards, labelled “Wi-Fi 无线” and “USB 有线”, each with its matching icon and a radio selection circle. The currently selected method's card expands IN PLACE to contain its instructions and brand/device details; the other remains one short compact row, visibly selectable. A subtle near-black outline indicates the active card. Fixed black bottom CTA. This version prioritizes beginner clarity; keep copy short enough that no content is clipped.
